## History

Evans attended a charity concert hosted at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where she observed the evening's entertainment alongside other wealthy attendees. Following a successful recitation by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Evans personally praised the young performer for her performance. She then continued to enjoy the remainder of the evening's festivities with the rest of the gathered audience.
